text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara gave it her all and finished 
the February Stakes full of energy.

The Trainer decided that her next race 
would be the Elm Stakes, a longer distance 
than this one.

Afterward, on the way to the Winning Live, 
Haru Urara ran into a friend who was 
feeling down after failing to win the 
race.

She felt bitter about not being able to 
win the race and take center stage for the 
Winning Live.

Having caught a glimpse of a side of her 
friend she had never seen before, Haru 
Urara was left completely stunned.
